name: a4_t2
setup: set -e; pip install -q numpy tokenizers matplotlib transformers==4.51.3; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; python -m babylm.data.prepare --download --splits train_10M,dev; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py; echo 'ad43c239fa2a47605c246748fee795a3070e0ad09f68cdc18eb0a880208bab07  babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py' | sha256sum -c -

jobs.name: a4_t2_generate
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/gen; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/gen/t2.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.generate --ckpt babylm/runs/a4_t2_G/resume.pt --out babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/gen/t2 --seed_split train_10M --block_split train_10M --words 100000000; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/gen/probe.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.generate --ckpt babylm/runs/a4_t2_G/resume.pt --out babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/gen/probe --seed_split train_10M --rows 2000

jobs.name: a4_t2_audit
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/audit; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/audit/leak.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.audit leak babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/syn_t2 --eval_dir /opt/babylm/osf/evaluation_data --out babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/audit/leak.json; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/audit/copy_t2.json ] || python -m babylm.a4.audit copy babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/syn_t2 --probe babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/gen/probe.jsonl.gz --out babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/audit/copy_t2.json

jobs.name: a4_t2
jobs.cmd: python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_a4_t2.json --only a4_t2 --device cuda; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2/result.json ] && { { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2/score/score.json ] || bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/a4_t2 /opt/babylm; }; [ -d babylm/runs/a4_t2/score/hf ] && { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2/score/dev_bpw_twin.json ] || /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/a4_t2/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/a4_t2/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/a4_t2/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo '[twin] a4_t2 failed'; }; python -m babylm.a4.t2 twin babylm/runs/a4_t2; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2/pt/pt_devfull_final.npy ] && { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2/pw/pw_devfull_final.npy ] || python -m babylm.analysis.perword babylm/runs/a4_t2 --epochs_only; }; }

jobs.name: a4_t2_n0
jobs.cmd: python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_a4_t2.json --only a4_t2_n0 --device cuda; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0/result.json ] && { { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0/score/score.json ] || bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0 /opt/babylm; }; [ -d babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0/score/hf ] && { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0/score/dev_bpw_twin.json ] || /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo '[twin] a4_t2_n0 failed'; }; python -m babylm.a4.t2 twin babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0; [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0/pt/pt_devfull_final.npy ] && { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0/pw/pw_devfull_final.npy ] || python -m babylm.analysis.perword babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0 --epochs_only; }; }

jobs.name: a4_t2_score_G
jobs.cmd: [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_G/result.json ] && { { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_G/score/score.json ] || bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/a4_t2_G /opt/babylm; }; [ -d babylm/runs/a4_t2_G/score/hf ] && { [ -f babylm/runs/a4_t2_G/score/dev_bpw_twin.json ] || /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/a4_t2_G/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/a4_t2_G/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/a4_t2_G/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo '[twin] a4_t2_G failed'; }; python -m babylm.a4.t2 twin babylm/runs/a4_t2_G; }

jobs.name: a4_t2_report
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/plots; for r in a4_t2_G a4_t2 a4_t2_n0; do [ -f babylm/runs/$r/curves.csv ] && python -m babylm.harness.plot_curves babylm/runs/$r; done; python -m babylm.harness.plot_curves babylm/runs/a4_t2_G babylm/runs/a4_t2 babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0 --out babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/plots/all; python -m babylm.a4.ledger babylm/runs/a4_t2 babylm/runs/a4_t2_n0 --base_epochs 10 --out babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/ledger.json

note: A4 T2 arm: closed-system augmentation (official FAQ), outside R0.2; never a strict-small entry; pool: moonshot. 10M stage batch 1, only after the A4 thread reads the gate as 'proceed' (base job base_S_wd0p4_lr0p5_r1_ve0_tied from ref-0065:babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json): G = the base args at 5 epochs, annealed (a4_t2_G); 100M synthetic words, the arm and N0'. One A100, sequential, about 2.7 h: maxdur 4 h. SOLO: every job alone on its GPU, never packed (critic ref-0027 / ref-0001: the screen's comparator is the solo seed-0 base). Preempted => relaunch the same file with env RESTORE_URI=<bucket>/vms/<old VM>/out/babylm/runs (every step skips what exists). Afterwards copy each run's small files (result.json, config.json, curves.csv, train_log.csv, log.jsonl, *.png, score/*.json incl. dev_bpw_twin.json, pw/ (the students' per-word dumps: the never-seen-character leg, critic ref-0001) and the students' per-token v2 dumps as for A4 batch 1 (experimenter 06:20Z)) and babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/{audit,plots,ledger.*,gate*} and babylm/runs/a4_t2_data/gen/*.json to shared/babylm/attacks/A4/t2/<run>/; keep the run dirs (G's resume.pt) in GCS; tell the A4 thread (it reads the audits first, then the verdict).
